strongest_new_near_candidate.actual_relevant_definition: def shortSquareProgression (N d b : ℕ) : ℝ := ∑ n ∈ range N, if Nat.lcm d (b^2) ∣ N - n then (vonMangoldt n : ℝ) else 0
strongest_new_near_candidate.complete_nearest_theorem_type: theorem shortSquareProgression_le {N : ℕ} (hN : 1 ≤ N) (d b : ℕ) : shortSquareProgression N d b ≤ (N / Nat.lcm d (b^2) : ℕ) * Real.log N
strongest_new_near_candidate.actual_proof_mechanism: Finite support injection using Nat.card_multiples', followed by a pointwise Mangoldt logarithm bound.
